scope: programme-level physics targets and source-set crosswalks; individual claim documents remain governed by their own status

coreTargets.label: Open-system contractive selection
coreTargets.targetObject: a return map with a measured fixed point, tangent spectral radius and independently calibrated second datum
coreTargets.observable: projector closure, coherent return, conditioned and unconditional map, contraction slope
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: open-system control, reservoir engineering and process tomography
coreTargets.principalGate: one physical platform must realize holonomy, monitoring, trajectories and a resource ledger without engineering the conclusion into the update law
coreTargets.killTest: remove the independent datum and test whether every orientation remains neutral or apparent contraction is explained by loss
coreTargets.usefulNull: validated system identification and robust-control bounds

coreTargets.label: Inverse detector design and equivalence classes
coreTargets.targetObject: the quotient of physical mechanisms by detector folding and nuisance directions
coreTargets.observable: nuisance-projected efficient information and global held-out mechanism separation
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: inverse problems, optimal experimental design and statistical identifiability
coreTargets.principalGate: build generative simulators and find the least-cost added channel that separates the worst unresolved mechanism pair
coreTargets.killTest: if the target tangent lies in the nuisance span, forbid sensitivity claims based on more repetitions of the same channel
coreTargets.usefulNull: calibration improvement and an explicit detector-equivalence class

coreTargets.label: Same-carrier thermoelectric--Casimir closure
coreTargets.targetObject: one measured causal material tensor predicting Hall, Seebeck, Nernst and boundary force or torque without refitting
coreTargets.observable: parallel-minus-antiparallel distance- and angle-dependent force or torque with propagated tensor uncertainty
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: Lifshitz theory, magneto-optics, thermoelectric transport and precision force metrology
coreTargets.principalGate: close the broadband diagonal and off-diagonal response of matched Co2MnGa films and beat electrostatic and magnetic nuisance floors
coreTargets.killTest: show that allowed optical tails or ordinary backgrounds span the proposed differential signal

coreTargets.label: Two-current Planckian transport
coreTargets.targetObject: the positive particle/energy-current spectral matrix and its robust rank
coreTargets.observable: C_NN, C_NE, C_EE, determinant and normalized determinant over frequency, filling and temperature
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: Kubo response, exact diagonalization and finite-temperature Lanczos transport
coreTargets.principalGate: build a compiled symmetry-resolved common-sample KPM or typicality calculation and scale the low-frequency particle/energy block through size, temperature and broadening
coreTargets.killTest: the integrated rank-two weight is expelled from every controlled low-frequency window or the window retains gauge dependence with size
coreTargets.usefulNull: a physical thermoelectric extension of strange-metal numerics

coreTargets.label: Phonon, magnon and hybrid-mode laboratories
coreTargets.targetObject: a controllable hybrid bosonic carrier with separated splitting, damping, holonomy and detector phase
coreTargets.observable: complex transfer matrices, avoided crossings, thermal Hall response and mode-resolved lifetimes
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: acoustic topology, cavity magnomechanics and magnon-polaron transport
coreTargets.principalGate: resolve a transported doublet or adversarially distinguish band geometry from scattering in one platform
coreTargets.killTest: loss, gain or interaction kinetics reproduces the headline geometric response

coreTargets.label: Non-Hermitian and Floquet geometry
coreTargets.targetObject: biorthogonal projectors, exceptional degeneracies and driven holonomy separated from nonunitary selection
coreTargets.observable: complex eigenvalues, left/right eigenvectors, singular values and rate/orientation reversal
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: non-Hermitian band theory and Floquet control
coreTargets.principalGate: reconstruct coherent holonomy and gain/loss-conditioned dynamics independently
coreTargets.killTest: endpoint exchange disappears or changes class under loop-rate reversal while complex topology is unchanged

coreTargets.label: Defects, domain walls and index-carrying boundaries
coreTargets.targetObject: a protected bulk--boundary or Fredholm index with a separately identified physical selector
coreTargets.observable: localized modes, spectral flow, endpoint representation and disorder robustness
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: topological phases, domain-wall fermions and index theory
coreTargets.principalGate: show which physical information beyond mode count is transported by the defect
coreTargets.killTest: construct a homotopic control with the same index but scrambled phase, representation or selector data
coreTargets.usefulNull: protected-channel devices and exact limits on index-based inference

coreTargets.label: Hydrodynamic stress and multichannel response
coreTargets.targetObject: frequency- and wavevector-resolved stress, diffusion, sound and thermoelectric response matrices
coreTargets.observable: pole structure, Ward identities, spectral rank and cross-channel residues
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: hydrodynamics, linear response and KMS constraints
coreTargets.principalGate: determine whether physical conservation laws leave an interior multichannel cone or a low-rank ray
coreTargets.killTest: distinct hidden spectra remain observationally equivalent after all accessible stress probes

coreTargets.label: Quantum-code and synthetic-gauge emulators
coreTargets.targetObject: finite symplectic shadows and logical holonomies generated only by provenance-bearing controls
coreTargets.observable: reachable logical group, gate word, leakage and tomography under source-restricted operations
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: qudit control, stabilizer codes and synthetic dimensions
coreTargets.principalGate: derive the allowed generators from the physical carrier rather than universal programmability
coreTargets.killTest: the target closure appears equally under arbitrary universal controls with no source-specific prediction

coreTargets.label: Scattering, causality and positivity bounds
coreTargets.targetObject: allowed regions of amplitudes or response functions stronger than ordinary consistency bounds
coreTargets.observable: dispersion inequalities, positive moments, pole/residue constraints and held-out cross sections
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: S-matrix bootstrap, EFT positivity and passive response theory
coreTargets.principalGate: derive one contextual-admissibility inequality not reducible to known unitarity, analyticity, causality or positivity
coreTargets.killTest: prove the proposed bound is a reparameterization of a standard positivity theorem
coreTargets.usefulNull: rigorous exclusion of inconsistent effective models

coreTargets.label: Flavour, neutrino and CP projector geometry
coreTargets.targetObject: a physical connection or path predicting a mass, texture or CP invariant without inserted Yukawa data
coreTargets.observable: oscillation likelihoods, texture zeros, Jarlskog invariants and Majorana-sensitive amplitudes
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: flavour phenomenology and global neutrino fits
coreTargets.principalGate: derive the path and overlap operator from one gauge-compatible action
coreTargets.killTest: held-out mixing or mass-order relations fail after parameter counting and correlated likelihood profiling

coreTargets.label: Precision gravity and torsion
coreTargets.targetObject: a radiatively controlled action producing a distinctive rotating-source or spin-dependent response
coreTargets.observable: species ratios, range dependence, spin orientation and cross-experiment coupling relations
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: Einstein--Cartan EFT, pseudoscalar forces and precision gravitation
coreTargets.principalGate: supply either a new UV protection theorem or a complete interacting fixed point and matched trajectory
coreTargets.killTest: generic pseudoscalar exchange or magnetic leakage fits every proposed signal with unconstrained coefficients
coreTargets.usefulNull: constraints on torsion and exotic spin forces

coreTargets.label: Cosmology, defects and vacuum selection
coreTargets.targetObject: one covariant model jointly predicting background expansion, perturbations, lensing, structure and relic defects
coreTargets.observable: CMB, distance ladder, growth, lensing and abundance likelihoods
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: ΛCDM extensions, modified gravity and defect cosmology
coreTargets.principalGate: reach a joined likelihood with common parameters and a controlled early-universe history
coreTargets.killTest: the model resolves one anomaly only by violating another cosmological dataset or adding unconstrained functions

coreTargets.label: Constructive continuum and mass-gap control
coreTargets.targetObject: regulator-, volume-, time- and operator-uniform spectral exclusion near zero
coreTargets.observable: finite-volume spectra plus certified uniform bounds and continuum convergence
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: constructive QFT, lattice gauge theory and spectral analysis
coreTargets.principalGate: produce a genuinely infinite-dimensional estimate rather than another finite scan
coreTargets.killTest: the claimed gap shrinks under volume, regulator or operator enlargement with no uniform lower bound
coreTargets.usefulNull: certified finite-lattice methods and precise obstruction statements

coreTargets.label: Thermodynamic cost of selection and learning
coreTargets.targetObject: a joint precision, speed, activity and dissipation budget for a physical selector
coreTargets.observable: trajectory entropy production, jump activity, work/heat, contraction and mixing time
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: stochastic thermodynamics and thermodynamic uncertainty relations
coreTargets.principalGate: compare equilibrium-biased, driven-cycle and measurement-conditioned selectors at matched apparent contraction
coreTargets.killTest: infer cost from slope alone or apply a steady-current theorem to equilibrium relaxation

coreTargets.label: Measurement backaction and monitored phases
coreTargets.targetObject: the separation of trajectory-conditioned selection, unconditional channel dynamics and stored records
coreTargets.observable: instrument tomography, outcome-conditioned states, ensemble maps and decoding complexity
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: continuous quantum measurement and measurement-induced phase transitions
coreTargets.principalGate: insert the selector datum into a monitored platform and retain full records without postselection ambiguity
coreTargets.killTest: trajectory purification occurs while the unconditional population map retains a fixed manifold

coreTargets.label: Renormalization and scale-stable admissibility
coreTargets.targetObject: the pushforward of admissible sets, invariants and exclusions under composable coarse-graining
coreTargets.observable: three-scale state, response and detector-equivalence maps with semigroup residuals
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: renormalization group, universality and model reduction
coreTargets.principalGate: construct one explicit three-scale carrier and identify invariants that survive without fitted basis maps
coreTargets.killTest: the apparent fixed geometry is generic under shuffled substitutions or depends on arbitrary coordinates
coreTargets.usefulNull: controlled reduced models and universality diagnostics

coreTargets.label: Rare-event and large-deviation geometry
coreTargets.targetObject: trajectory rate functions and escape paths beyond mean response
coreTargets.observable: dwell-time, first-passage, switching-path and current distributions under reversal
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: Kramers escape, large deviations and metastability
coreTargets.principalGate: distinguish equilibrium breaking from kinetic freezing over waiting time and sweep rate
coreTargets.killTest: one relaxation time or hysteresis width fits incompatible path ensembles

coreTargets.label: Complexity and computational admissibility
coreTargets.targetObject: the separation of physical existence, efficient preparation, sampling, detection and verification
coreTargets.observable: resource scaling with system size and approximation error
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: computational complexity, simulation and verification theory
coreTargets.principalGate: enforce the five-stage existence/preparation/sampling/detection/verification card on every newly active emulator, experiment and numerical claim
coreTargets.killTest: the claimed frontier requires exponential tomography or an unrestricted oracle hidden in preparation

coreTargets.label: Causal spread, scrambling and speed limits
coreTargets.targetObject: bounds on the propagation rate of selection, disturbance and information
coreTargets.observable: local perturbation fronts, OTOCs, mixing time and system-bath coupling bounds
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: Lieb--Robinson bounds, open-system speed limits and scrambling
coreTargets.principalGate: compare observed selector mixing with a calibrated propagation/resource bound
coreTargets.killTest: apparently super-fast global selection is explained by common drive, long-range coupling or analysis leakage

coreTargets.label: Disorder, localization and glassy memory
coreTargets.targetObject: robustness of projectors, topology and selection under quenched and self-generated disorder
coreTargets.observable: gap statistics, closure error, return slopes, sample variation and rare dwell tails
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: Anderson localization, Griffiths effects and glassy dynamics
coreTargets.principalGate: jointly scale disorder strength, sample count and waiting time on one carrier
coreTargets.killTest: a supposed vacuum multiplicity is sample-specific kinetic memory or a rare-region effect

coreTargets.label: Triality quotient scars and hidden-mode recovery
coreTargets.targetObject: a four-mode hub-and-three-outer carrier whose cyclic quotient deletes a contrast doublet while retaining nonlinear and integral scars
coreTargets.observable: bright and dark poles, lumped memory, quadratic and cubic waiting-time invariants, oriented Vandermonde sign and cyclic-reversal response
coreTargets.nearestConventionalPhysics: multimode system identification, hidden Markov dynamics, resonator networks and singularity monodromy
coreTargets.principalGate: realize exact and weak cyclic symmetry with individual, summed and oriented contrast records in one calibrated platform
coreTargets.killTest: the linked signatures disappear after gain, bandwidth, relabeling and ordinary hidden-state nuisances are fitted, or no contrast modes exist under individual readout
coreTargets.usefulNull: a calibrated theorem-scale demonstration of information lost and recovered under detector quotienting

activePriority.packet: platform selector with holonomy, monitoring, trajectories and thermodynamic ledger
Co2MnGa causal tensor and nuisance-floor closure

portfolio.newPhysicsRule: A target becomes a new-physics candidate only after its conventional comparator, detector equivalence class, nuisance model, recovery limit and preregistered kill test are closed.
portfolio.stopRule: Do not add another abstract selector toy before fixing a platform with measurable trajectories and resources.

terminalNewPhysicsGates.reopenRequirement: an explicit grading or nonrenormalization theorem distinguishing the parent invariants through every threshold
a computed interacting fixed point, critical surface and matched trajectory to laboratory scales
